rules.name: No tracked .env file
rules.remediation: Tracked .env files almost always leak secrets. Add to .gitignore and commit only .env.example.

rules.name: .env.example present
rules.remediation: Document required env keys in a tracked .env.example (no real values).

rules.name: .envrc.example present (direnv users)
rules.remediation: Pair tracked .envrc.example with the gitignored .envrc so direnv users can bootstrap.

rules.name: No tracked private-key files
rules.remediation: Private keys must never be committed.
